backend_schedule.semantics: Same complete trainers, schedules, targets, source, RNG seeds, ledgers and epoch60. Independent processes; scheduling only; no bitwise or speedup claim. DP serial because measured combined peaks exceed card. Own nominal caches run serial before either rear trainer; offline runs serial after both. Rear pair admitted before either starts; otherwise both trainers run serial. Any launched failure is terminal, never a training retry. External CPU/GPU processes remain recorded in original telemetry. Only their presence veto is removed; telemetry errors, actual remaining capacity, source checks, native leases, and finite cleanup remain.
limitations: Parent process_rss telemetry is monitor RSS, not trainer RSS; 6GiB/worker is a conservative admission bound, not a measured parent peak.
Current v4 exact owner argv does not recognize this caller; use proposed watcher adapter after old writer exits.
Cooperative pause retains resident memory and cannot preempt submitted CUDA; no zero-interference guarantee.
Keep actual presealed_guard --mode main before evaluation.

scheduling: Native distinct own-DP caches run parallel only if actual combined RAM/VRAM admission permits; otherwise serial. Same rule for rear trainers. Offline serial. No scientific worker/body retries.
evaluation_resource_scope: Scoped wait applies only to exact backend prepare/cache/train/offline workers. Development/test keep native physical owners and failure propagation; no body retry, outcome-dependent rerun or physical opportunity replacement is added.
